note: Retrieval v1 (PLAN §11.1 G2, M2): natural-language questions written by the developer from the article texts of the 2026-10-16 sample (no copied article wording; some keyword-style queries), each with 1-3 target articles (grade 2 = answers the question, 1 = related). DE/EN items ask the same legal points without French keywords (worst case: the LLM did not reformulate). Not lawyer-validated; the curated query expansion (lgx_mcp/retrieval/query_expansion.yaml) was written before these questions from general legal vocabulary, but by the same author: report ablations. Targets frozen by `python -m eval.harness freeze-g2` (key, act, article, text_sha256). M2 review (2026-10-17): G2-206–G2-218 ask about PDF code-recueil articles (pdf: true; targets pinned by the page of the heading in pdftotext, independent of the parser); `leak` = longest run of the question's tokens found verbatim in the first target (eval/harness/leak.py), `leaky` when ≥ 5.
